title: The Broken Loom
scene: At 3:35 PM, the studio loom was sabotaged. The weaving room was locked from 3:15 to 3:55.

suspects.name: Iris Vale
suspects.testimony: I was dyeing yarn in the yard at 3:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The dye log shows Iris's vat at 3:33.

suspects.name: Jonas Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the market stall at 3:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The stall camera shows Jonas at 3:34.

suspects.name: Kayla Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the weaving room at 3:35, threading the loom.
suspects.contradiction: The weaving room was locked from outside, and cut threads were on Kayla's sleeve.

suspects.name: Lionel Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the office at 3:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The office camera shows Lionel at 3:32 and 3:41.
